analysis.evidence: The suffix ךָ identifies whom God will make into a nation, and לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל specifies the promised result, “into a great nation.”
analysis.morphology: The conjunction וְ precedes a Qal imperfect, first person common singular. The object suffix ךָ is second person masculine singular and refers to Abram.

analysis.evidence: In וְאֶעֶשְׂךָ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל, “I will make you into a great nation,” גּוֹי names the people God promises will come from Abram.
analysis.morphology: The prefixed preposition לְ marks the result of וְאֶעֶשְׂךָ, “I will make you.” The noun is masculine singular absolute, and the adjective גָּדוֹל agrees with it.
analysis.sense: a people counted as a nation
